description.en:
Adds dynamic alternating wig-wag emergency light patterns to all vehicles using native vehicle lights. No custom light nodes required - works universally across all FS25 vehicles.
Features: - 4 escalating emergency patterns - Pattern 1: Turn Signals (Left / Right alternating) - Pattern 2: Turns + Low/High Beams + Brake - Pattern 3: Full Wig-Wag with Reverse Lights - Pattern 4: Maximum Emergency with Running Lights - Variable phase timing for realistic, organic flash rhythm - Adjustable flash speed from 50ms to 1000ms (default 150ms) - Syncs to all attached implements automatically - On-screen HUD overlay shows active pattern and speed
Controls: - Shift + Page Up: Toggle emergency lights on/off - Shift + Page Down: Cycle through patterns - Ctrl + Shift + Page Up: Increase flash speed - Ctrl + Shift + Page Down: Decrease flash speed
